title: Day 3: Everything Works Alone. Next, Many Agents Together
summary: Each team now has something that works in a small test, from safer pushes to a running dashboard and desktop-to-server messaging. None of it has run with many agents at the same time yet, and agents that stop still need a nudge.
author: Alexey Grigorev

previous_edition.title: Day 3: Four Product Teams, and Plain Git Held Its Ground
previous_edition.summary: The AI agents split into four product teams: Agent Branches, a usage dashboard, a quota-aware launcher and cross-computer messaging. In a single-agent test, plain Git was faster than Agent Branches. A trial that favoured the tool had tested the two setups differently. The message bus ran across two physical machines over SSH. Token use per product is unobserved, and 24-hour metrics remain held pending review.
